name: Diamond Dust
description: Tiny crystals that hang in the air, flicker and drift: dots and four-point glints, as a full background or a strip under a title.

props.name: density
props.description: Particles per 100,000 square pixels. A strip under a title wants several hundred.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Radius of the smallest particle, in pixels.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Radius of the largest particle, in pixels. Particles in the upper part of the range are drawn as four-point glints.

props.name: direction
props.description: `down` is light snowfall, `up` is rising mist, `none` hovers in place.

props.name: color
props.description: Particle colour. Without it, water by day and a blue-white at night. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: twinkle
props.description: Let each particle flicker at its own rate.

props.name: glints
props.description: Draws the largest sparkles as four-point glints. Turn it off for round flakes, which read as falling snow rather than stars.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Ease particles away from the pointer. Off under reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the particles. Other div props are passed through.
